description: This file defines the EditNoteActivity class for an Android app, handling creating and editing notes with a UI, interacting with a NotesRepository, and managing user input and menu actions.

classes.name: EditNoteActivity
classes.description: An activity that allows the user to create a new note or edit an existing one, with toolbar support and interaction with NotesRepository.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and loads an existing note if editing.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including saving notes and navigating up.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates and saves the note via the repository, providing user feedback.
